summary.text: Andrea Reeb, also known as Andi, is a Republican who represented District 64 in the New Mexico House of Representatives from January 1, 2023, until she resigned on October 15, 2026.

Source NM reported that she resigned after a federal judge ruled that holding her House seat while serving as a special prosecutor in the Alec Baldwin case violated the state constitution's separation of powers; she appeared unopposed on the November 3, 2026 ballot for District 64 and, the Albuquerque Journal reported, announced on November 5 that she would rejoin the Legislature in January.

paragraphs.text: Andrea Reeb was born in Clovis, New Mexico, and graduated from Clovis High School in 1989.

She worked as an attorney, serving as assistant district attorney for the 9th Judicial District, senior trial prosecutor, chief deputy attorney and district attorney in Clovis, and as an adjunct professor at Clovis Community College.
Reeb assumed office in the New Mexico House of Representatives on January 1, 2023, succeeding Randal Crowder.
Ballotpedia records that she resigned from the House on October 15, 2026.

In an October 15 statement she said she respectfully disagreed with the court but was resigning to continue her work as a special prosecutor, and that she had relied on guidance from the State Ethics Commission and the Attorney General to serve in both roles.

The Albuquerque Journal reported that the deadline for candidates to withdraw from the ballot had passed when she resigned, so she appeared unopposed on the general election ballot, and that she said she had not done anything wrong and was still considering an appeal of the ruling.
